text: These results indicate severe acute liver failure with significantly impaired synthetic function, given the low prothrombin activity and elevated INR. speaker: Doctor
text: The negative hepatitis and toxicology screens rule out common viral and drug-induced causes for his acute liver failure. I need to investigate other potential etiologies like autoimmune hepatitis or metabolic disorders, so I will request an autoimmune liver panel and metabolic workup. REQUEST TEST: Autoimmune_Liver_Panel, Metabolic_Workup

speaker: Doctor
text: With viral, toxic, and autoimmune causes ruled out, I suspect a metabolic or genetic disorder like Wilson disease or acute fatty liver of pregnancy is unlikely given his gender, so I need to check for copper metabolism issues. REQUEST TEST: Serum_Ceruloplasmin, Urine_Copper

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative workup for common causes of acute liver failure in a young male with agitation, I suspect Wilson disease despite normal ceruloplasmin, or possibly acute ischemic hepatitis from a cardiac event. REQUEST TEST: Slit_Lamp_Exam, Echocardiogram

speaker: Doctor
text: With standard causes ruled out, I suspect acute liver failure due to acetaminophen toxicity, which can be missed on standard screens if not specifically tested or if the ingestion was recent. REQUEST TEST: Acetaminophen_Level

speaker: Doctor
text: The elevated acetaminophen level confirms acetaminophen-induced acute liver failure. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acetaminophen-induced acute liver failure
